description: Add an SBOM (Software Bill of Materials) generation step to an existing Harness pipeline using Harness SCS SscaOrchestration (SBOM Orchestration). Supports container images and code repositories. Sources: docker, ECR, GCR, GAR, ACR, Harness AR (har), repository, and local workspace. Syft or cdxgen, SPDX or CycloneDX, optional SBOM attestation. Only works with existing pipelines. Use when asked to create an SBOM, generate a bill of materials, add SBOM to a pipeline, scan a container image or repo for components, or set up SBOM Orchestration. Trigger phrases: create SBOM, generate SBOM, add SBOM step, SBOM for image, SBOM for repo, scan for dependencies, SBOM Orchestration, add Generate SBOM step.
